purpose: Y_hist — district x season x crop historical yield for the transparent yield estimator (docs/yield/yield-estimation.md).
reproduce: 1. GET the download_url below with a browser User-Agent (a HEAD request returns 403). No API key, no authentication.
2. Save it to local_path and verify sha256 matches.
The build refuses to run if the sha256 does not match this manifest, so a silent input swap cannot rewrite the yields a farmer sees.

license.verification_status: UNRESOLVED — the catalogue field and the site footer name different attribution licences, and the portal's copyright policy page is client-rendered and could not be captured. All three permit commercial use with attribution, so the discrepancy does not change what we may do; the exact text is still owed to datasets/licenses/. Handled the way ADR-012 handles PlantVillage's contested licence: comply with the strictest reading, record the conflict, do not redistribute.

sources.redistribution: NOT redistributed. The raw CSV is gitignored and permission-denied for writes so it cannot be modified in place; only this manifest, the quality report and the derived lookup are committed.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, via data.gov.in (OGD Platform India)

temporal_coverage.note: Live-verified: crop_year 2013 → 13650 rows, 2014 → 10973, 2015 → 562 (partial), 2016 and later → 0. Effective end is 2014-15, eight years short of the primary.

credentials.status: DATAGOVIN_API_KEY is open decision OD-5 and remains unset in this repository. Nothing in the yield feature depends on it — the primary source needs no key.
credentials.probe_note: The verification probes used data.gov.in's own published sample key, which the portal prints on every resource page. It is a documented public demo credential, not a secret; it appears nowhere in this repository, and its quota was exhausted partway through the audit, which is precisely why it cannot serve a product.

fidelityChecks.check: district sums against published all-India totals
fidelityChecks.result: UNRESOLVED — district sums run ~14–15% above the published all-India wheat and rice figures while every yield matches. Recorded as open rather than rationalised. Cannot affect this feature: the estimator reads per-district yields and never sums them.

transformations: Crop scope filtered to registry crops carrying `yield.apyCropName` in backend/src/knowledge/crops.base.json (7 of 9; COTTON and TOMATO excluded by decision, reasons recorded on the crop).
Season labels mapped exactly: Kharif→KHARIF, Rabi→RABI, Summer→ZAID. Total→ALL_SEASON tier, Whole Year→ANNUAL tier. Autumn and Winter left UNRESOLVED and dropped.
Unit labels asserted, not converted: a row not declaring Hectare/Tonnes/Tonnes-per-Hectare is dropped.
Agricultural year '1997-1998' parsed to start year 1997, with the second year required to be the first plus one.
Rows with area <= 0, production blank or <= 0, or yield <= 0 dropped and counted (a nil return is not a zero yield).
Published yield re-derived from production/area and required to agree within max(0.005, 2%).

Implausibly high yields flagged by an Iglewicz-Hoaglin modified z-score (published threshold 3.5) on log10 yield, per crop, UPPER TAIL ONLY — low yields are real crop failures and trimming them would bias every estimate optimistically.
Surviving rows aggregated to a median over the last 5 available years per key, with the sample standard deviation over the same window, requiring at least 3 observations.
NOTHING is repaired, rescaled or imputed. Every rejection is counted, and the material ones are listed by district and year in the quality report.
